sql_calls.sql:
SELECT SUM(units_sold) AS units_june, SUM(revenue_inr) AS revenue_june
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01';

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY status;

SELECT audit_ts, status
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY audit_ts;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS lines_june, SUM(l.qty) AS units_june, SUM(l.line_amount) AS amount_june
FROM store.pos_lines l
JOIN store.products p ON p.sku = l.sku_scanned
WHERE p.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND l.bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND l.bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01';
